```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(purrr)
  library(readr)
  library(stringr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(here)
  library(knitr)
})
```

```{r}
to_num <- function(x) {
  parse_number(as.character(x), locale = locale(decimal_mark = ","))
}

load_survey <- function(folder, condition) {
  df <- read_delim(
    here("data/survey", folder, "dataset.csv"),
    delim = ";",
    col_types = cols(.default = col_character()),
    na = c("", "\"\"", "NA")
  )

  if (!"statoverall_4" %in% names(df)) {
    df$statoverall_4 <- "1"
  }

  df |>
    mutate(
      condition = condition,
      complete = to_num(statoverall_4) == 1
    )
}

gender_labels <- read_delim(
  here("data/survey/csv_humanai/labels.csv"),
  delim = ";",
  col_names = c("variable", "value", "label"),
  col_types = cols(.default = col_character())
) |>
  filter(variable == "b_2") |>
  transmute(gender_code = value, gender = str_squish(label))

survey <- bind_rows(
  load_survey("csv_humanai", "Human-AI"),
  load_survey("csv_humanhuman", "Human-Human")
)

survey |>
  mutate(age = to_num(b_3)) |>
  group_by(condition) |>
  summarise(
    rows = n(),
    complete_rows = sum(complete, na.rm = TRUE),
    gender_n = sum(!is.na(b_2) & complete %in% TRUE),
    age_n = sum(!is.na(age) & complete %in% TRUE),
    age_mean = if_else(age_n > 0, mean(age[complete %in% TRUE], na.rm = TRUE), NA_real_),
    age_sd = if_else(age_n > 1, sd(age[complete %in% TRUE], na.rm = TRUE), NA_real_),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 2))) |>
  kable(caption = "Survey sample summary")
```

```{r}
survey |>
  filter(complete) |>
  mutate(gender_code = coalesce(b_2, "missing")) |>
  left_join(gender_labels, by = "gender_code") |>
  mutate(gender = coalesce(gender, "Missing")) |>
  count(condition, gender, name = "n") |>
  group_by(condition) |>
  mutate(percent = 100 * n / sum(n)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(percent = round(percent, 1)) |>
  arrange(condition, desc(n)) |>
  kable(caption = "Gender distribution among complete survey rows")
```

```{r}
items <- tribble(
  ~variable, ~item,
  "s_94", "collaboration support",
  "s_95", "helpfulness",
  "s_96", "enjoyment",
  "s_92", "ownership",
  "s_93", "perceived contribution",
  "s_43", "LLM use frequency",
  "b_3",  "age"
)

rating_summary <- survey |>
  filter(complete) |>
  select(condition, any_of(items$variable)) |>
  pivot_longer(-condition, names_to = "variable", values_to = "raw_value") |>
  mutate(value = to_num(raw_value)) |>
  filter(!is.na(value)) |>
  inner_join(items, by = "variable") |>
  group_by(item, variable, condition) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean = mean(value),
    sd = sd(value),
    median = median(value),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

rating_summary |>
  mutate(across(c(mean, sd, median), \(x) round(x, 2))) |>
  arrange(variable, condition) |>
  kable(caption = "Complete-response numeric survey items")
```

```{r}
rating_summary |>
  select(item, variable, condition, mean) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = condition, values_from = mean) |>
  filter(!is.na(`Human-AI`), !is.na(`Human-Human`)) |>
  mutate(`Human-AI - Human-Human` = `Human-AI` - `Human-Human`) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 2))) |>
  arrange(variable) |>
  kable(caption = "Mean differences on numeric items present in both conditions")
```
